rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for planning and creating a picture, artwork, structure, or other work.

example.english: I want to design a new house with a rooftop.
example.traditional: 我想設計一個有天台嘅新屋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 cit3 gai3 jat1 go3 jau5 tin1 toi4 ge3 san1 uk1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a specification, overall plan, or design as a field of study.

example.english: This design still needs a few changes before it can be implemented.
example.traditional: 呢份設計仲要改幾個位先可以落實。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 cit3 gai3 zung6 jiu3 goi2 gei2 go3 wai2 sin1 ho2 ji5 lok6 sat6

rows.note: Use this for the style, model, or outward appearance of an object, especially clothing or consumer goods.

example.english: The design of this shirt is simple and goes best with jeans.
example.traditional: 呢件衫嘅款式夠簡單，襯牛仔褲最好。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 fun2 sik1 gau3 gaan2 daan1 can3 ngau4 zai2 fu3 zeoi3 hou2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a decorative pattern or motif on clothing, artwork, or architecture.

example.english: I want to add a flower design to the front of the bag.
example.traditional: 我想喺袋面加個花嘅圖案。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 doi6 min6 gaa1 go3 faa1 ge3 tou4 on3

rows.note: Use this for someone's intention or underlying plan, including a potentially ulterior design.

example.english: The design behind this arrangement was to undermine the opponent.
example.traditional: 呢項安排背後嘅意圖係打擊對手。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 on1 paai4 bui3 hau6 ge3 ji3 tou4 hai6 daa2 gik1 deoi3 sau2
